description: This PHP source file handles the setup and display logic for the 'Unified Search Modules' feature in the vtiger CRM system. It loads configuration, performs database queries to determine permitted modules, and uses Smarty templating to render the interface.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty templating engine subclass used specifically in vtiger CRM for rendering views.

methods.name: display()
methods.description: Renders the specified Smarty template to the browser.
